# Dependencies

## Core
- hyprland
- quickshell

## Portals
- xdg-desktop-portal
- xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland
- xdg-desktop-portal-gtk

## Audio
- pipewire

## Appearance
- Bibata cursor theme (Bibata-Modern-Ice)
- Icon theme (not chosen yet)

## Fonts
- IBM Plex Mono with Nerd Font icons (BlexMono Nerd Font)
- Google Sans Flex (general UI)
- Material Symbols (icons)
- Twemoji (emoji)

## Used by the Hyprland config
- kitty
- zen-browser
- thunar
- fuzzel (temporary launcher until the shell provides one)
- wl-clipboard
- cliphist
- brightnessctl
- playerctl

## Terminal
- fish 4.0 or newer (kitty's shell)
- starship (prompt)
- fzf 0.48 or newer and fd (fzf key bindings, `fcd`, `fe`)
- eza (optional, nicer `ls`)

## Neovim
- neovim 0.12 or newer (`vim.pack`, ui2)
- git and curl (plugin installs and the blink.cmp binary)
- ripgrep, fd and fzf (fzf-lua)
- lua-language-server, basedpyright and qmlls (language servers)
